summary: Gate 1 (Email Protection) + Guard tab 'Network & Accounts' section verified end-to-end at mobile viewport 390x844. Backend: POST /api/patrol/events accepts category='email' scenario='E01' (200), event persists via GET /api/patrol/events, /api/message/analyse continues to accept the extra {scenario, signals, claimed_brand} extras — 3/3 backend tests pass. Frontend: home-check-email-button + home-check-network-button + home-check-account-button + home-verify-button all render on Home. /email screen: E01 (impersonated CommBank) → Barking, scenario 'E01', brand 'Claims: CommBank', verdict text 'This email says it\'s from CommBank, but it wasn\'t sent from CommBank. It wants you to log in — that\'s how they take the account.', email-sender-domain pill 'cb-alerts-secure.top — not CommBank\'s domain', email-links card lists the URL with 'Not CommBank\'s site' pill and email-check-link-0 routes to /check, email-check-account + email-verify-sender + email-recovery-open all present. E11 (genuine commbank.com.au) → Patrolling / 'E11' / 'commbank.com.au — official' / no recovery-open. E03 (Invoice_4471.pdf.exe) → Barking / 'E03' / email-attachments card lists the file with 'Risky type' and email-check-file routes to /file. E04 (changed bank details) → Barking / 'E04'. E13 (ordinary mum@gmail.com) → Patrolling / 'E13'; email-again resets the form; email-tech opens the technical sheet; email-close returns to /home. GUARD tab: 'Network & Accounts' section renders guard-network-card (status pill 'Active', summary 'Connected via unknown. No unresolved network issues.', guard-open-network routes to /network) and guard-account-card (status pill flips from 'All good' → '1 needs attention' after running one account event, guard-account-summary shows 'Fake CommBank security alert — My bank', guard-open-account routes to /account). Capabilities section still renders below with guard-cap-site_guard, guard-cap-link_guard, etc. Patrol tab lists both the Email and Account events after the flow. Regression smoke: /message, /check, /app-check, /network, /account all open and close cleanly — no red screens, no console errors. ONE BUG FOUND: the Threat Scent linkage from /email → /account never fires because the recentLinked filter in /app/frontend/app/account.tsx:66 whitelists categories ['message','website','link','call','app','connection'] and OMITS 'email'; the assertions 'account-linked text mentioning the email (Threat Scent)' and 'account-scent-notice card' in the request therefore fail.

integration_issues.flow: Gate 1 Email → Account Guard cross-gate Threat Scent
integration_issues.issue: After E01 email check, tapping email-check-account correctly navigates to /account and pre-fills account-text with the email body plus scent query param. However, /app/frontend/app/account.tsx line 66 filters recentLinked by category in ['message','website','link','call','app','connection'] — it does NOT include 'email'. Consequence: account-scent-notice card is never rendered and, after account-run with mfa_prompt+bank+initiated_no, account-state is 'Barking' but account-linked text ('• Connected to: Email: … (Threat Scent).') is never rendered. Fix: add 'email' to the category whitelist on line 66.

action_items: MAIN AGENT FIX (business-logic, 1-line): In /app/frontend/app/account.tsx line 66, extend the category whitelist inside the recentLinked useMemo filter to include 'email' so that events created by /email are considered when computing the Threat Scent for /account. After the fix, retest the cross-gate: E01 email → email-check-account → mfa_prompt + bank + initiated_no → account-run → assert account-scent-notice card is visible with 'about CommBank' text AND account-linked text 'Connected to: Email: Email impersonating CommBank (Threat Scent)' is rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/account.tsx:66 — recentLinked category whitelist is out of sync with the new Gate 1 category 'email'; when a new category is added to PatrolEvent (see /app/backend/server.py:159 Literal[...] which correctly includes 'email'), the frontend cross-gate scent filter must be updated too. Consider deriving the whitelist from a single shared const to prevent this class of drift.

/app/frontend/app/email.tsx L65 — scent_id is not populated on the email event before upsertEvent; the account.tsx flow derives its own scent via linked?.scent_id || linked?.event_id, so this works today, but if the email event is later linked from another gate the missing scent_id will make linkage brittle. Consider setting scent_id = event_id at creation time so downstream gates always have a stable id.

/app/frontend/app/email.tsx L107 — email-sender-domain pill uses scenario-string regex /E01|E07/ to decide tone/label. Fine today, but coupling display copy to scenario codes is fragile; a boolean 'senderMismatch' from the analyser would be cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% — 13 of the 14 explicit assertions pass; the Threat Scent linkage (account-linked / account-scent-notice) is the sole miss and is caused by the account.tsx whitelist bug above.

seed_data_creation: None persisted — each browser session starts fresh; tests do onboarding via onboarding-start-button → disclosure-accept-button. Backend test data uses TEST_ prefix and is safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce the account-linked bug: onboarding → home-check-email-button → paste the E01 forwarded email → email-run → scroll to email-check-account → tap → on /account: account-kind-mfa_prompt + account-provider-bank + account-initiated-no + account-run → wait ~6s for backend → observe that document.querySelector('[data-testid="account-linked"]') returns null even though document.querySelector('[data-testid="account-state"]') is 'Barking'. Cause & fix pinpointed in account.tsx line 66 recentLinked filter. All other Gate 1 scenarios (E01, E03, E04, E11, E13) and Guard tab section are verified working. Backend patrol event category='email' works — pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_email.py.
rca_of_issue: Gate 1 introduced a new PatrolEvent.category value ('email') and the backend Literal in /app/backend/server.py:159 was updated to accept it. The consumer side of the Threat Scent feature in /app/frontend/app/account.tsx:66 filters events for linkage via an explicit category whitelist that was NOT extended to include 'email'. Because /app/frontend/app/email.tsx creates its patrol event with category:'email' (see email.tsx:65), when /account is opened with a scent hint from that email, `recentLinked` is empty → account-scent-notice is never rendered and the eventual result.linked is null → account-linked text is never rendered. Mitigation: add 'email' to the whitelist array on account.tsx line 66 (single-line change) then retest the cross-gate assertions.
